source: Official ECMAScript2026 specification accessed through webtool; live algorithm read, no whole HTML archived

observations.paraphrase: For a strict ordinary function, the supplied thisArgument is kept rather than substituted with a global object.
A property reference uses its receiver; other identifier references use the environment WithBaseObject result.
A declarative environment supplies undefined for this implicit call receiver.
The in operator rejects a nonobject right operand with TypeError before membership lookup.

inference: Given reached plain call to lexically declared strict checkExistence and falsy name, its this is undefined; reached instance in this throws TypeError. Earlier wrapper property accesses/helpercalls may fail first; not all lookups throw.
